messages:
Oliver: FYI — customer acct-867 hit an issue with the console CSV export. Their report rows are out of chronological order and several records are split across multiple lines. They attached a sample and say their ingestion pipeline failed. @Maya can you triage? :warning:
Maya: Thanks. Can you paste the sample CSV and the report query? My first thought is quoting/newline handling in the notes field, or a sort that ran on string values.
Oliver: Pasted sample (sanitized):
```
report_date,customer_id,notes
10/3/2025,867,"First line of note
continued note line"
2/1/2025,123,"Single line note"
9/15/2025,444,"Another note"
"Orphan line that looks like a row, because the previous quote was closed incorrectly"
```
Oliver: You can see the date order is wrong too: 10/3/2025 appears before 2/1/2025 in the exported file for this customer.
Jun: I think I see the bug. The exporter is using a naive CSV writer and we wrote a sort key as the raw string for the date column (no parsing). So sorting is lexicographic. Also the quoting logic drops quotes when an internal CRLF exists, then downstream consumer treats the continuation line as a separate row. Repro steps: on prod run export API POST /reports/export with payload report_id=867, include_field=notes, limit=2000; compare file.
Maya: Severity? Customer impact?
Oliver: They say ~2k rows affected, breaks their downstream ingestion. They're Dedicated and on paid plan — customer is pushing to fix quickly. I set P1 for support ticket and flagged account team.
Oliver: @Jun can you estimate ETA for a fix?
Jun: Short-term workaround: export as TSV (tab delim) or have them set the "preserve newlines" flag in the exporter UI which temporarily wraps fields differently. Medium-term fix: parse date into ISO8601 before sorting, and switch to RFC4180-compliant quoting and escape internal CRLFs by replacing with the unicode line separator when exporting. I'll open PR and run canary. ETA for canary patch: ~2 hours.
export-bot: Deploy request created: exporter/1799999999-rfc4180-quotes -> canary -> prod (manual promote).
Emily: FYI Excel on Windows tends to break on embedded CRLFs even if CSV is valid. Normalizing to \n and replacing internal newlines with U+2028 works better for Excel. We should add a toggle: "normalize line breaks for Excel" on the export modal.
Jun: Patch pushed to canary, added unit tests for multi-line fields and date parsing. Verified on staging: sample file now preserves notes as a single quoted field and rows are sorted by parsed date (ISO).
Oliver: Communicated workaround and that a fix is deploying. Customer will re-download in ~30m.
Oliver (30m): Customer confirmed their ingestion succeeded with the new file. They asked for a short RCA and a request to include a "TSV" option permanently.
Maya: I'll write RCA note in the ticket and follow up with product about TSV/normalize toggle. Moving ticket to monitoring; will close if no regressions in 24h.
Jun: Follow-up items: (1) make exporter parse & store date sort key server-side, (2) add normalization toggle in UI, (3) add end-to-end test with Excel opening. I created GH issues #4521 #4522 #4523.
Oliver: Thanks team. Closing loop with customer and account owner.
